name: nexus-v1
description: NEXUS V1 personal digital universe and Resume Studio monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @nexus/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:web dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/shared && npm run build --workspace @nexus/api && npm --workspace @nexus/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nexus/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/api && npm --workspace @nexus/web run typecheck
